prompt: Analyze frequently purchased product combinations to identify common bundles in the sales data. Compare how these co-purchase patterns vary across store locations and seasonal time periods.
title: Co-Purchase Bundle Analysis
summary: Analyze frequently purchased product combinations to identify common bundles in the sales data. Compare how these co-purchase patterns vary across store locations and seasonal time periods.
executed_sql_queries:
SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date, s.store_name AS store_location, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS line_item_count, SUM(oi.quantity) AS item_quantity_sum
FROM retail.orders o
JOIN retail.stores s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
LEFT JOIN retail.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
GROUP BY o.order_id, o.order_date, s.store_name
ORDER BY o.order_date, o.order_id
LIMIT 50 OFFSET 0

SELECT o.order_id,
       COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) AS distinct_product_count,
       CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS pair_bundle_flag,
       CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS triple_bundle_flag,
       SUM(oi.total_amount) AS total_order_amount
FROM retail.orders o
JOIN retail.order_items oi
  ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2020-01-01'
  AND o.order_date < DATE '2023-01-01'
GROUP BY o.order_id
ORDER BY o.order_id
LIMIT 100

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS order_year, o.store_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS distinct_order_count, COUNT(*) AS order_item_count, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(oi.total_amount) AS total_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) AS distinct_product_count FROM retail.orders o JOIN retail.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) IN (2023, 2024, 2025, 2026) GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date), o.store_id ORDER BY order_year, o.store_id LIMIT 100

SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS orders_containing_product, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(oi.total_amount) AS total_sales_amount FROM retail.order_items oi JOIN retail.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY orders_containing_product DESC, total_quantity DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.store_id, o.order_date, oi.order_item_id, oi.product_id, oi.quantity, oi.unit_price, oi.discount_percent, oi.discount_amount, oi.total_amount
FROM retail.orders o
JOIN retail.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2020-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2021-01-01'
ORDER BY o.order_id, oi.order_item_id
LIMIT 50 OFFSET 0

SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.store_id, o.order_date, oi.order_item_id, oi.product_id, oi.quantity, oi.unit_price, oi.discount_percent, oi.discount_amount, oi.total_amount
FROM retail.orders o
JOIN retail.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2021-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2022-01-01'
ORDER BY o.order_date, o.order_id, oi.order_item_id
LIMIT 50 OFFSET 0

SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.store_id, o.order_date, oi.order_item_id, oi.product_id, oi.quantity, oi.unit_price, oi.discount_percent, oi.discount_amount, oi.total_amount
FROM retail.orders o
JOIN retail.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2023-01-01'
ORDER BY o.order_date, o.order_id, oi.order_item_id
LIMIT 50 OFFSET 0

SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.store_id, o.order_date, oi.order_item_id, oi.product_id, oi.quantity, oi.unit_price, oi.discount_percent, oi.discount_amount, oi.total_amount FROM retail.orders o JOIN retail.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2023-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2024-01-01' ORDER BY o.order_id, oi.order_item_id LIMIT 50 OFFSET 0

SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.store_id, o.order_date, oi.order_item_id, oi.product_id, oi.quantity, oi.unit_price, oi.discount_percent, oi.discount_amount, oi.total_amount
FROM retail.orders o
JOIN retail.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) IN (2024, 2025, 2026)
ORDER BY o.order_date, o.order_id, oi.order_item_id
LIMIT 50 OFFSET 0

SELECT store_id, store_name, rls_user_id, is_online FROM retail.stores WHERE store_name IN ('Zava Retail Bellevue','Zava Retail Everett','Zava Retail Kirkland','Zava Retail Online','Zava Retail Redmond','Zava Retail Seattle','Zava Retail Spokane','Zava Retail Tacoma') ORDER BY store_id
SELECT order_id, order_date, customer_id, store_id FROM retail.orders WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2020-01-01' AND DATE '2026-12-31' ORDER BY order_date, order_id LIMIT 100

SELECT MIN(order_date) AS min_order_date, MAX(order_date) AS max_order_date, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) AS order_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_date) AS order_month, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM retail.orders GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_date) ORDER BY order_year, order_month

WITH join_order_id AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS joined_rows,
         COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS matched_orders
  FROM retail.orders o
  JOIN retail.order_items oi
    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
),
join_order_id_store_id AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS joined_rows,
         COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS matched_orders
  FROM retail.orders o
  JOIN retail.order_items oi
    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
   AND o.store_id = oi.store_id
),
base_orders AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders
  FROM retail.orders
),
base_order_items AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_order_items
  FROM retail.order_items
)
SELECT 'order_id_only' AS join_type,
       j.joined_rows,
       j.matched_orders,
       b.total_orders,
       i.total_order_items
FROM join_order_id j
CROSS JOIN base_orders b
CROSS JOIN base_order_items i
UNION ALL
SELECT 'order_id_plus_store_id' AS join_type,
       j.joined_rows,
       j.matched_orders,
       b.total_orders,
       i.total_order_items
FROM join_order_id_store_id j
CROSS JOIN base_orders b
CROSS JOIN base_order_items i;

SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date, s.store_name AS location, o.store_id, oi.order_item_id, oi.product_id, oi.quantity, oi.unit_price, oi.discount_percent, oi.discount_amount, oi.total_amount FROM retail.orders o JOIN retail.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id AND o.store_id = oi.store_id JOIN retail.stores s ON o.store_id = s.store_id WHERE o.order_date = (SELECT MIN(order_date) FROM retail.orders) ORDER BY o.order_date, o.order_id, oi.order_item_id LIMIT 25 OFFSET 0

SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.store_id, o.order_date, oi.order_item_id, oi.product_id, oi.quantity, oi.unit_price, oi.discount_percent, oi.discount_amount, oi.total_amount, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS order_year, CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_date) IN (12,1,2) THEN 'Winter' WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_date) IN (3,4,5) THEN 'Spring' WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_date) IN (6,7,8) THEN 'Summer' ELSE 'Fall' END AS seasonal_group FROM retail.orders o JOIN retail.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) BETWEEN 2022 AND 2024 ORDER BY o.order_date, o.order_id, oi.order_item_id LIMIT 50 OFFSET 0

SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.store_id, o.order_date, oi.order_item_id, oi.product_id, oi.quantity, oi.unit_price, oi.discount_percent, oi.discount_amount, oi.total_amount, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS order_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM o.order_date) AS order_quarter FROM retail.orders o JOIN retail.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id ORDER BY o.order_date DESC, o.order_id DESC, oi.order_item_id ASC LIMIT 50 OFFSET 0
